decisions.decision: ProfileScreen large avatar placeholder uses DSColors.surface (not DSColors.primary)
decisions.rationale: UI-SPEC distinguishes 48px header placeholder (primary/Electric Green) from 80px ProfileScreen placeholder (surface/off-white). Large initials on Electric Green would be visually overwhelming.

decisions.decision: PreferencesScreen Switch does not set thumbColor
decisions.rationale: Electric Green thumb on Electric Green track is invisible. Only trackColor is set.

decisions.decision: discardConfirmed ref (not state) used to bypass beforeRemove listener on confirmed Discard
decisions.rationale: State update is async and would not be read in time by the beforeRemove listener; ref is synchronous.
